not_verified_on_staging_reason: This lane adds three migration files, a pgTAP test, read-only check SQL and rollbacks. Nothing is applied from the PR: each file is applied later through RUN-MIGRATION.yml, one file per dispatch, after the owner approves the files and the target database (collaboration.md section 7d). Staging shares the production database, and nothing deployed reads daily_matches.scope or calls intent_pool_allows (the recompute and screens that do ship in later lanes behind mt.network_enabled; the gateway still passes p_visibility 'public' to search_intent_catalog_v2, which after the apply means the network rule), so the staging deploy runs no code that reads anything new. Staging writes to the production Supabase project (rules 31/31b/48), so the matchers and the guard trigger are never exercised there: they are proven by the pgTAP file on a local stack. The post-apply check is read-only: docs/validation/VTID-05575/live-before.sql before, post-apply-checks.sql after, rollback-check.sql after a rollback, run by Kiro through RUN-MIGRATION's read-only check. No suite points at vitanaland.com.
